about: Conformance vectors for the mythos.effect-reconciliation/v2 receipt: the signed answer of one provider readback about a dispatch, v1 with action_ref in place of action_digest and readback.response_ref in place of readback.response_digest -- each a keyed reference, as observed-effect-v5.json has them, under the same tags -- and keyed_under; permit_digest is unchanged. Generated by mythos-core (mythos_core/observed_effect.py, tests/observed_effect_vectors.py). Each valid case records the inputs it is built from: the plain digests are there and nowhere in a receipt. The first valid receipt is a readback of the dispatch observed-effect-v5.json signs, under the same chain key, so its action_ref is that document's. Every invalid document is refused with its code, and every invalid envelope with its verdict and code, against a keyring that files the effect key under effect_engine and the gate key under achilles. Each signing key is Ed25519 with the private seed SHA-256 of its phrase and the chain key is the SHA-256 of its phrase: test keys, public by construction, never a real one. Keys, payloads and signatures are written as hex (payload_hex, sig_hex): an envelope's base64 fields are the base64 of those bytes; a field written as payload or sig is as posted.
chain_key_phrase: mythos.observed-effect/v5 conformance vector: the engine's chain test key, never a real one
effect_key_phrase: mythos.effect-reconciliation/v2 conformance vector: the observed-effect test key, never a real one
gate_key_phrase: mythos.effect-reconciliation/v2 conformance vector: the gate's outcome test key, never a real one

valid.name: applied: the readback answered applied (HTTP 200), concluded committed; the dispatch observed-effect-v5.json signs, under the same chain key
not_applied: the readback answered not_applied (HTTP 200), concluded failed
cannot_say over HTTP 503 (the one status allowed besides 200, and only for this answer), concluded unknown
a retry: attempt 2 under the same dispatch id (the same idempotency key), its own gate decision and permit, read back applied
